# AI Trust Commons

> Nikhil Singhal's AI governance work. The home page, "AI governance in practice", follows one sales contract in nine steps as people and AI agents hand work between teams and companies. Each handoff passes through a policy gate.

Writing is licensed CC BY 4.0. Credit Nikhil Singhal.

## Main pages

- [AI governance in practice, plain text](https://aitrustcommons.org/ai-governance-in-practice.md): the home page's words without the design
- [About Nikhil Singhal](https://aitrustcommons.org/about/): who he is and his published work
- [The HIP Charter](https://aitrustcommons.org/hip-charter/): the Human Intelligence Partnership Charter. Four patterns of human-AI partnership and the gap between human intent and machine execution at every pattern. Plain text: https://aitrustcommons.org/hip-charter.md
- [From Instinct to Intent™](https://aitrustcommons.org/blog/category/from-instinct-to-intent-series/): his article series on the gap between what a person means and what the machine does
- [Blog](https://aitrustcommons.org/blog/): all posts
